Scenario: Post a balanced two-line entry
Preconditions: An open period exists; the user holds Create and the reviewer holds Approve and Post.
Input: Dr 115033 Security Fence 100,000,000 / Cr 111002 Project Safe 100,000,000, PRJ-01, CC-SEC, counterparty CN-02, cash account 111002, document Complete.
Expected accounting entry: One header with two lines, debit = credit = 100,000,000.
Expected system behaviour: Entry moves Draft → Submitted → Reviewed → Approved → Posted and receives the next JV number.
Expected report impact: Trial balance 115033 debit +100,000,000; Cash Position 111002 payments +100,000,000; CIP register additions +100,000,000.
Expected control result: VR-01, VR-04, VR-05, VR-06 all pass.

Scenario: Reject an unbalanced entry
Expected system behaviour: Posting is blocked with a message naming the 10,000,000 difference.
Expected report impact: No report changes.

Scenario: Reject a posting to a non-posting parent
Preconditions: Account 115030 exists as a non-posting parent.
Expected system behaviour: The account is not selectable and the API rejects it.
Expected report impact: No report changes.

Scenario: Reject a posting to an inactive account
Expected system behaviour: The account is not selectable and the API rejects it.
Expected report impact: No report changes.

Scenario: Reject a line carrying both a debit and a credit
Input: A line with debit 5,000,000 and credit 5,000,000.
Expected system behaviour: Validation error on the line.
Expected report impact: File 2 integrity counter stays at zero.

Scenario: Post a multi-line entry (one debit, three credits)
Expected accounting entry: One header, four lines, total debit = total credit = 300,000,000.
Expected system behaviour: Entry posts normally.
Expected report impact: Contractor subledger shows the recovery, the retention and the payment.

Scenario: Reject a posting into a closed period
Expected system behaviour: Posting is blocked naming the period and its status.
Expected report impact: No report changes.

Scenario: Reopen a closed period with authorisation
Preconditions: Period 2023-05 is at Final Close; the user is the Finance Manager.
Expected system behaviour: Period status returns to Open; the reason is mandatory.
Expected report impact: RPT-28 shows the reopening; RPT-32 records it as a high-risk action.
Expected control result: VR-09 and the audit rule both apply.

Scenario: Prevent a user approving his own entry
Preconditions: A Senior Accountant created the entry.
Input: The same user attempts Review and Approve.
Expected system behaviour: Blocked with a maker–checker message.
Expected report impact: Entry remains Submitted.

Scenario: Prevent editing a posted entry
Expected system behaviour: Blocked; the system offers reversal or adjustment instead.
Expected report impact: No report changes.

Scenario: Reverse a posted entry
Preconditions: A posted entry of 100,000,000 exists in an open period.
Expected accounting entry: A new entry mirroring the original, linked to it.
Expected system behaviour: Original is marked Reversed; both remain visible.
Expected report impact: Trial balance net effect is nil; RPT-26 shows both entries.

Scenario: Shareholder funding received in cash
Expected system behaviour: Entry posts as TT-01.
Expected report impact: RPT-11 funding +500,000,000; Cash Position receipts +500,000,000; RPT-20 Level 1 +500,000,000.

Scenario: Direct payment by the shareholder to a supplier
Input: IQD 25,000,000 paid directly by SH-01 for fibre works; actual payment source "Eidan Company bank account".
Expected system behaviour: Entry posts as TT-02 with no cash account.
Expected report impact: RPT-11 funding +25,000,000; CIP 115050 +25,000,000; Cash Position unchanged.
Expected control result: VR-11 blocks any attempt to add a cash account.

Scenario: Spending project funds does not reduce the shareholder loan
Expected system behaviour: Entry posts.
Expected report impact: RPT-11 closing loan is unchanged at 38,043,476,980.
Expected control result: VR-20 — the test is that the loan does NOT move.

Scenario: Third-party funding is not posted to a shareholder loan
Preconditions: Board approval exists for Hassan Yaqoub.
Expected accounting entry: Dr 111002 7,125,000 / Cr 211090 7,125,000 with the counterparty named.
Expected system behaviour: Entry posts as TT-03; any attempt to credit 221001 is blocked.
Expected report impact: RPT-11 excludes it; SFP payables +7,125,000.

Scenario: Issue an advance to a custodian
Input: IQD 200,000,000 issued from 111002 with a purpose and a 90-day deadline.
Expected system behaviour: An advance record is created with status Open.
Expected report impact: RPT-13 outstanding +200,000,000; RPT-14 shows it in the 0–30 bucket.
Expected control result: VR-07, VR-25 pass; VR-25 blocks any attempt to debit an expense instead.

Scenario: Issuing an advance may not be expensed
Input: Attempt Dr 610001 / Cr 111002 flagged as an advance issue.
Expected system behaviour: Blocked.
Expected report impact: No report changes.

Scenario: Settle an advance to CAPEX on approved documents
Input: Settlement of 150,000,000 to 115033 with an invoice attached.
Expected system behaviour: A settlement record is created; the advance falls to 50,000,000.
Expected report impact: RPT-13 outstanding 50,000,000; CIP +150,000,000; RPT-15 shows the classification.

Scenario: An advance may not be settled by crediting an expense account
Expected system behaviour: Blocked with the posting-direction message.
Expected report impact: No report changes.

Scenario: Reclassify unsupported custody spend to a personal receivable
Expected system behaviour: Entry posts as TT-12 with the approval reference.
Expected report impact: RPT-13 advance falls; SFP personal receivables +62,528,000; the combined position of the person is unchanged.

Scenario: Advance aging and the overdue exception
Preconditions: An advance is outstanding past its settlement deadline.
Input: Run RPT-14 as at a date after the deadline.
Expected system behaviour: The advance appears in the Overdue bucket.
Expected report impact: RPT-14 and RPT-24 both show it.

Scenario: Contractor advance and its recovery
Preconditions: Contract CT-0001 exists with a 20% recovery rate.
Input: Advance 1,000,000,000; later a certificate of 2,000,000,000 with a 400,000,000 recovery.
Expected accounting entry: Dr 112020 / Cr 111002 for the advance; Dr 115xxx / Cr 211003 for the certificate; Dr 211003 / Cr 112020 for the recovery.
Expected system behaviour: All three post; cumulative recovery is tracked.
Expected report impact: RPT-16 shows advance, certified, recovery and payable; RPT-17 agrees to the GL.

Scenario: Recovery may not exceed the advance issued
Expected system behaviour: Blocked.
Expected report impact: No report changes.

Scenario: Retention withholding
Expected system behaviour: Retention posts.
Expected report impact: RPT-16 retention held 100,000,000; SFP retention payable +100,000,000.

Scenario: Payment may not exceed the outstanding payable
Expected system behaviour: Blocked.
Expected report impact: No report changes.

Scenario: Capitalise a project cost to Concession CIP
Input: IQD 300,000,000 of civil works with asset class Concession CIP and handover required.
Expected system behaviour: Entry posts.
Expected report impact: RPT-18 additions +300,000,000 with the handover classification.

Scenario: Transfer from CIP to the concession right is blocked before the operation date
Preconditions: The commercial operation date parameter is NULL.
Expected system behaviour: Blocked naming the missing parameter.
Expected report impact: No report changes.
Expected control result: VR-39 blocks — the system must never assume a commercial operation date.

Scenario: Transfer from CIP after the operation date is set
Preconditions: The Finance Manager sets the commercial operation date with a board reference.
Expected system behaviour: Entry posts as TT-23.
Expected report impact: RPT-18 transfers out; SFP concession rights increase; CIP falls.
Expected control result: VR-39 now passes; the parameter change is in RPT-32.

Scenario: Amortization may not precede the operation date
Preconditions: The commercial operation date is set to a future date.
Input: An amortization run with an earlier effective date.
Expected system behaviour: Blocked.
Expected report impact: No report changes.

Scenario: Recognise operating revenue
Preconditions: Revenue accounts exist and the yard is operating.
Input: IQD 100,000,000 of truck entry fees, flagged eligible.
Expected system behaviour: Entry posts as TT-27.
Expected report impact: P&L gross revenue +100,000,000; RPT-19 eligible revenue +100,000,000.

Scenario: Compute and recognise the 20% share
Preconditions: Eligible revenue of 100,000,000 exists and the rate parameter is 0.20.
Input: Run the government share for the period.
Expected system behaviour: The run produces exactly one entry per period.
Expected report impact: P&L government share 20,000,000; RPT-19 due = recognised; SFP government liabilities +20,000,000.

Scenario: The share is not computed on funding
Preconditions: Shareholder funding of 500,000,000 was received in the same period.
Expected system behaviour: The funding is excluded from the base.
Expected report impact: RPT-19 base excludes the funding.

Scenario: The rate is read from the parameter table
Preconditions: The rate is changed to 0.25 effective from a future date.
Input: Run the share for a period before and after that date.
Expected accounting entry: Two runs at two different rates.
Expected system behaviour: Each run uses the rate effective for its period.
Expected report impact: RPT-19 shows the rate applied.

Scenario: Cash Position book balance is derived, not entered
Expected system behaviour: The book balance field is read-only and agrees to the account ledger.
Expected report impact: RPT-10 book balance equals the RPT-05 closing balance of 111002.
Expected control result: VR-57 — the field cannot be edited.

Scenario: Bank reconciliation with a variance
Input: Actual balance per statement is 495,000,000 with the statement attached.
Expected system behaviour: Variance of 5,000,000; status remains Unreconciled; an exception is raised.
Expected report impact: RPT-10 shows the variance; RPT-24 shows the exception.

Scenario: Transfer between two cash accounts
Expected system behaviour: Entry posts as TT-06.
Expected report impact: Cash Position shows a payment on one and a receipt on the other; total cash is unchanged.

Scenario: Cash shortfall goes to suspense and opens an exception
Preconditions: A funded amount of 100,000,000 with 96,196,500 received.
Expected system behaviour: Entry posts and an exception opens automatically.
Expected report impact: RPT-24 shows the suspense item; the dashboard suspense KPI is non-zero.

Scenario: Clearing suspense requires a resolution
Expected system behaviour: Entry posts; the exception closes with the resolution recorded.
Expected report impact: RPT-24 shows the exception as Resolved with its resolution text.

Scenario: Duplicate detection on amount, counterparty and period
Preconditions: A posted entry of 17,000,000 to Amer Essam exists in December 2024.
Input: A second entry with the same amount, counterparty and month.
Expected system behaviour: A duplicate flag is raised; posting requires a disposition.
Expected report impact: RPT-22 shows the flag and the value at risk.

Scenario: Duplicate source reference is blocked
Preconditions: Source reference DF-12 is already used.
Expected system behaviour: A duplicate flag of type Source Reference is raised.
Expected report impact: RPT-22 shows the flag.

Scenario: Missing documents stay visible
Preconditions: An entry is posted with document status Missing.
Input: Run RPT-24 and attempt to remove the exception.
Expected system behaviour: The exception cannot be deleted; it can only be resolved by attaching the document.
Expected report impact: RPT-24 and the dashboard both show the missing-document count.

Scenario: An undated historical entry keeps its status
Preconditions: A migrated entry carries date_status NO DATE IN SOURCE.
Input: Open it and attempt to set a date.
Expected accounting entry: No change unless evidence is attached.
Expected system behaviour: The system refuses a date without a supporting document and records the change in the audit log when one is given.
Expected report impact: RPT-24 shows it among undated entries; the count remains 311 until evidence arrives.

Scenario: Approved reclassification changes only the account
Input: Reclassify to 610019 with a board reference.
Expected accounting entry: Dr 610019 / Cr 115099 for the same amount.
Expected system behaviour: The amount, date, description and source reference of the original are unchanged.
Expected report impact: RPT-26 shows old and new account; the trial balance moves between the two accounts only.

Scenario: Trial balance proves in both directions
Preconditions: The full migrated population is loaded.
Expected system behaviour: Total debit movement = total credit movement = 83,989,216,460; net debit balances = net credit balances = 38,150,397,980.
Expected report impact: All three control lines read BALANCED.

Scenario: Balance sheet balances from the mapping table
Expected system behaviour: Assets − (Liabilities + Equity) = 0.
Expected report impact: Every line traces to its mapped accounts.
Expected control result: VR-55 — no figure is stored or typed.

Scenario: Drill-down from statement to document
Preconditions: A posted entry with an attachment exists.
Input: From RPT-06, drill to the trial balance, the account ledger, the journal entry and the document.
Expected system behaviour: Each step opens the next with the filters carried through.
Expected report impact: The document opens from the journal entry.

Scenario: Filters apply consistently across reports
Preconditions: Data exists for all three projects.
Input: Apply project = PRJ-03 on RPT-04, RPT-06, RPT-07 and RPT-30.
Expected system behaviour: All four reports return the same population.
Expected report impact: PRJ-03 totals agree across the four reports.

Scenario: Monthly closing checklist gates the final close
Expected system behaviour: Blocked, listing the incomplete tasks.
Expected report impact: RPT-28 shows the completion percentage.

Scenario: A read-only user cannot post
Preconditions: A Management Read Only user is logged in.
Input: Attempt to create or post an entry.
Expected system behaviour: The functions are not available and the API rejects the call.
Expected report impact: No report changes.

Scenario: Every change is logged with old and new values
Preconditions: A COA account name is changed under approval.
Expected system behaviour: An audit row records user, timestamp, field, old value, new value and reason.
Expected report impact: RPT-32 shows the change.

Scenario: Migrated data reconciles to the source workbook
Expected system behaviour: Every one of the 30 migration controls reads Pass.
Expected report impact: Counts, totals, per-account balances, project totals, funding totals, advance balances and duplicate counts all agree.
Expected control result: Go-live acceptance condition — the system is not accepted until every control passes.

Scenario: The open difference survives migration
Expected system behaviour: Account 112035 shows a net credit of 99,796,000 and the chain control reports it as an open difference.
Expected report impact: RPT-21 lists it with its named causes.
Expected control result: The difference must NOT have been closed, netted or plugged by the migration.
